autocomplete.purpose: Suggest valid entities while preserving typing control, loading feedback, keyboard selection, and no-result recovery.
useWhen: Users must enter or choose a valid entity from remote or large data.
Suggestions reduce errors without blocking free typing too early.
Loading, no-result, and selected states need to be explicit.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The option set is short and stable enough for Select.
Suggestion source, validation timing, or selection persistence is unclear.
Users can accidentally submit stale or unauthorized suggestions.
foundations: Defines suggestion layer width, row density, and mobile fallback.
Owns hint, suggestion labels, loading copy, and no-result recovery.
Controls focus, highlighted suggestion, and selected value.
Suggestion layer appears above nearby content without obscuring form context.
Idle, typing, loading, suggestions, selected, no results, and error states are explicit.
Requires labelled input, keyboard navigation, active option announcement, and Escape close.
slots: Typed query, filtered suggestions, selected value, and combobox/listbox semantics.
Selectable results with metadata inside the Combobox option layer.
Shown when selected value is required or stale.
variants: Skeleton or progress appears while remote results load.
motion: Layer appears after typing and closes with selection or Escape.
Skeleton resolves into suggestions without moving focus.
Selected suggestion updates input and validation state.
accessibility: Combobox has visible label, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and active option semantics.
Keyboard users can reach and select suggestions.
Loading and no-result states are announced.
Escape closes suggestions without clearing input.
Selected value remains distinguishable from typed text.
tests: Typing in Combobox opens and filters suggestions.
Loading state appears before suggestions when configured.
Selecting a Combobox option writes the selected value.
Escape closes suggestions and preserves typed input.

canDecide: Use Autocomplete for large or remote entity sets.
Use Skeleton for async suggestion loading.
Show Empty State when no suggestions match.
mustAsk: Validation source, stale suggestion policy, permissions, or free-text fallback is unclear.
rejectIf: Loading or no-result states are missing.
miel.handoff: Confirm data source, selection policy, async behavior, free-text rules, and validation.
